title: Console inbox scratchpad — morning sweep
content:
2026-03-12 morning sweep (quick brain dump)
Owner: Samir Patel — obs inbox
Context: personal working notes for console/observability queue. Not a blamelog — quick reproductions, next steps, and who to ping.

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] INC-4217: anonymous customers seeing 502s on /v1/generate (spike 03:40-03:55 UTC) — priority: P1
    - quick findings: heatmap shows error spike concentrated in us-east-1 region, route group console-api-prod, model small-lm-v2 variants.
    - reproduction steps: run k6 load pattern locally against staging console-api-prod with seq_len=512 for 20s (use load-config-sim.json) — earlier attempts reproduced 504s, not 502s.
    - quick command: kubectl -n console logs deploy/console-api-prod -c api --since=15m | grep "502" | head -n 50
    - todo: check fallback routing logs (smart-router) for model-swap events around 03:40; see OBS-339 for smart-router trace IDs.
    - ping: @Nora (possible routing rule change), @diego (kernel OOM suspicion).

- [ ] OBS-339: dashboard widget blank on some orgs (reported by ACME corp) — priority: P2
    - user message snippet: "graph disappears after 1m and then never returns, we rely on this metric for alerts"
    - initial note: likely frontend cache miskeying when org-level tags include commas — seen similar bug in front-end release 0.24.1.
    - quick repro: login as org-acme (staging), open /dash/metrics, toggle time range.  If blank, check network logs for 200 with empty payload vs 500.
    - possible workaround: ask customer to pin shorter window, but need fix in frontend caching layer.
    - assign to: Nora to confirm. I will draft quick repro steps and attach HAR.

Lower priority / follow-ups
- [ ] GH-1023 (console: add graceful fallback for model variants) — blocked, waiting on infra design doc.
- [ ] small UX nit: tooltip on token-cost card shows stale numbers — likely cache TTL. Quick fix candidate for 0.25.0.

Notes & quick diagnostics (things I ran)
- Ran k6 against staging for 10m (seq_len 256) — observed 1.2% error rate, trace ids: trace-20260312-1, trace-20260312-2. Saved traces to /tmp/obs-traces-mar12.tar.gz
- Checked node exporter for pod console-api-prod-7bdc: memory spikes correlate with errors (RSS +120MB at 03:41). No OOMs reported.
- Smart-router logs: saw 3 instances of fallback-to-variant: small-lm-v2->small-lm-v2-quant; need to check compatibility matrix for that model pair.

Quick action plan (this session ~90m)
1) Reproduce 502 on staging — 20m (k6)
2) grep smart-router logs for model-swap and fallback events — 15m
3) Collect traces and upload to OBS traces bucket + attach to INC-4217 — 10m
4) Draft message to ACME about dashboard workaround if reproducible — 15m
5) Slack ping to Nora & Diego with short summary and links — 5m
Remaining time: 25m buffer for pairing with Nora if needed.

Open questions / TODOs
- Where did the sudden model-swap policy come from? Check PR history around 0.24.0 in infra-routing repo. (GH PRs to check: infra-routing#451, infra-routing#448)
- Confirm whether small-lm-v2 quantized variant was recently onboarded to dedicated pools — could be placement churn.
- Should we enable temporary 5xx alert suppression during controlled rollback? Ops input needed.

Messages to send (drafts)
- To Nora (DM): "Heads-up — seeing 502 spike in us-east-1 around 03:40. Repro in staging with k6. Suspect smart-router fallback + model variant mismatch. Can you check routing rules and recent commits to infra-routing? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4217"
- To ACME (CS draft): "We're investigating the dashboard blanking; as a temporary workaround please try setting the time window to 15m and refresh. We'll follow up with a permanent fix after reproducing in staging."

Scratch: quick log snippets
- "2026-03-12T03:41:02Z ERROR api: upstream returned 502 for request id=trace-20260312-1 route=gen"
- "smart-router: fallback applied -> variant small-lm-v2-quant reason=capacity_shortfall"

Attachment plan
- HAR for dashboard blanking (if repro) — attach to OBS-339
- k6 load config + raw traces -> upload to INC-4217

Later notes (after midday pairing)
- Paired with Nora at 11:00 — confirmed cache key bug in frontend (comma-delimited tags). Nora will prepare hotfix branch.
- Diego found kernel memory overhead on older instances (g3a-8x) — infra suggested draining those and replacing with g4i-8x where base image has updated drivers. Filed infra ticket INFRA-820.

End-of-day checklist
- [ ] Attach traces and HARs to tickets
- [ ] Follow up on Nora hotfix PR and test in staging
- [ ] Confirm infra drain schedule with Diego

Random notes / to self
- Remember to add a short snippet to the runbook: "If console 502 spike correlates with fallback events -> check model variant compatibility and capacity pools"
- Make short example for SDK team showing how to detect 502 pattern via streaming traces (will help CS alerting).
